units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:1:6">Y. Sabb. XVI, 15ᶜ</cite> <he>כיון שהרגיש בקול פַּעֲמוֹתָיו וכ׳</he> when he perceived the sound of R. Yishmael’s foosteps.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:2:1">Cant. R. to VII, 2</cite> <he>אינו מדבר אלא בפַעֲמֵי רגלים</he> the verse speaks of the steps of the festive pilgrimages; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:2:3">ib.</cite> <he>ומה היה יפיין לפְעָמַיִךְ וכ׳</he> and what was the beauty of ‘thy footsteps?’ That they locked the door for all troubles (no troubles arose in the homes of the pilgrims during their absence). Lam. R. introd. (R. Naḥm.) <he>ולא היו עולין לפעמי רגלים</he> they have not gone up on festive pilgrimages; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 302">Yalk. Is. 302</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Shabbat 12b:5">Sabb. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ אחת קרא וכ׳</he> once it happened that he read &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:4">Pes. X, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 116a:10">116ᵃ</cite>) <he>שבכל הלילות אין אנו מטבילין אלא פ׳ אחת וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) all other nights we dip (eatables) only once, and this night twice.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18:4">Gen. R. s. 18</cite> <he>וחזר ובראה לו פ׳ שניה</he> and he created her a second time; <he>הדא היא דכתיב זאת הפ׳ זאת היא של אותו הפ׳</he> therefore it is written (<cite ref="Genesis 2:23">Gen. II, 23</cite>) ‘this the time’, this is (the creation) of this time; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּעָמִים</he>. Pes. l. c.
Yoma I, 6 פ׳ הרבה וכ׳ many a time I read to him from Daniel; a. fr.—פ׳ ש־ at times, sometimes.

Lev. R. s. 35, end פ׳ שעושה בזכות וכ׳ sometimes he makes (rain) for the sake of one man &c.; Y. Taan. III, 66ᶜ top. Cant. R. l. c. פעמים הללו פ׳ מכוסין פ׳ מגולין those steps (of the travellers) are at times covered, at times uncovered; a. fr.—Du. פַּעֲמַיִם twice.
<cite ref="Sotah 42a:16">Sot. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ מדבר עמם וכ׳</he> he addresses them twice, once &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:16:2">Cant. R. to II, 16</cite> <he>ואני … בכל יום פ׳ וכ׳</he> and I declare the unity of his name twice every day (saying), Hear, O Israel, &c.; a. fr.
